race.comment: MOON ZONE (11) had been racing well with two consecutive placings before motoring late after she missed the start when fourth over 1300m at Moree. Close to a win this time. JAGERSCHNITZEL (8) returned from a let-up with a slashing run from near last on the turn to finish a narrow third over 1200m at Mudgee. Looking for this trip now and his lone win came at this course. MRS BULL (12) deep into the prep and awkwardly drawn for this. Stretched out to the mile with an eye catching third at Narromine. Has a strong record here over this trip and sure to be thereabouts. LANG PARK (1) gets a better set-up for this and worth thought.
